courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 隧道震波地質探測
related.titleEn: Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation
related.transfer: 可遷移「回次與深度閉合」與「乘法指標敏感」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道震波地質探測的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Runs and depth closure" and "Multiplicative index sensitivity" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從回次、節理與試驗代表性推導岩體分類的適用邊界；隧道震波地質探測則以分辨震波反射、速度模型與定位不確定性，將預測交由鑽孔驗證為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on derive rock-mass classification boundaries from runs, discontinuities and test representativeness; Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation centres on distinguish seismic reflections, velocity models and location uncertainty before borehole validation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「回次與深度閉合」與「阻抗反差與反射」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道震波地質探測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「波速與彈性假設」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Runs and depth closure” and “Impedance contrast and reflection”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Velocity and elastic assumptions", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 孔內電視與裂隙判釋
related.transfer: 可遷移「回次與深度閉合」與「乘法指標敏感」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；孔內電視與裂隙判釋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Runs and depth closure" and "Multiplicative index sensitivity" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從回次、節理與試驗代表性推導岩體分類的適用邊界；孔內電視與裂隙判釋則以以孔壁成像幾何、方位校準及水力交叉證據辨識裂隙為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on derive rock-mass classification boundaries from runs, discontinuities and test representativeness; Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation centres on interpret fractures through borehole-image geometry, orientation calibration and hydraulic cross-checks, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「回次與深度閉合」與「光學與聲學互補」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到孔內電視與裂隙判釋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「裂隙組與取樣偏差」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Runs and depth closure” and “Optical and acoustic complementarity”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Joint sets and sampling bias", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鑽孔岩心記錄與岩體分類
history.text: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示從回次、節理與試驗代表性推導岩體分類的適用邊界需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why derive rock-mass classification boundaries from runs, discontinuities and test representativeness requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
